title: PowerupsPlugin
description: Adds 33 new powerful powerups to the game!
body:
Adds 33 unique, game-changing Powerups to your world, earned through PvP, crafting, and a bit of luck. # How It Works - Everyone starts with 3 Powerup Rolls. Use /roll to open a GUI and get a choice between two random Powerups.

- Kill another player to steal one of their Rolls. If they have zero, you get nothing.

- Craft a Powerup Roll with 4 Diamond Blocks, 4 Netherite Ingots, and a Nether Star in the middle.

- You can have up to 10 active Powerups. Manage them with ```/powerups``` or turn them back into items with ```/removepowerup```.
# The Powerups Here is a full list of every Powerup you can get, organized by rarity. Common (50%) Pig Spawner: 10% chance to spawn a pig when you break a block. (Max: 10) Mining Fatigue: 1% chance to inflict Mining Fatigue V for 3s on hit. (Max: 3) Breaking Madness: Gain +0.01% Haste for every block broken in a row. (Max: 10) Damage Multiplicator: Deal 1.05x more damage. (Max: 5) Uncommon (30%) Blindness: 5% chance to blind an enemy for 2s on hit. (Max: 2) Speed: Grants permanent Speed I. (Max: 1) Hunger: Restore 0.5 hunger bars every 1 minute. (Max: 1) Fire Resistance: Grants permanent Fire Resistance. (Max: 1) Creeper!: Get a creeper egg via /creeper (1h cooldown). (Max: 3) Food Plz!: Get random food via /food (20s cooldown). (Max: 2) Rare (10%) Poison: 5% chance to inflict Poison II for 5s on hit. (Max: 2) Fortune!: 30% chance per level to apply Fortune III when breaking an ore. (Max: 3) Leap: Leap 5 blocks forward via /leap (1m cooldown). (Max: 2) Mining Dream!: Gain Haste V for 5s via /miningdream (3m cooldown). (Max: 1) Silk Touch: Your tools permanently have Silk Touch. (Max: 1) Slowness: 10% chance to inflict Slowness on hit. (Max: 1) Food Gambler!: 15% chance per level for an Absorption heart for 25s when eating. (Max: 2) Jumper!: Jump 30 blocks into the air via /jumper (2m cooldown). (Max: 1) Legendary (6.5%) Heart: Adds 1 extra max heart. (Max: 5) Strength!: Deal 1.2x more damage. (Max: 3) Fly??: Fly for 3 seconds using /fly (5m cooldown). (Max: 1) Double Food!: Gain 1.5x saturation and hunger from food. (Max: 1) No Fall Damage: You no longer take fall damage. (Max: 1) Mythic (3%) Resistance: Grants permanent Resistance I. (Max: 3) Hunger? what's that!: You no longer lose hunger. (Max: 1) I'm not giving up yet!: Teleports you 30 blocks away at 2 hearts (30m cooldown). (Max: 1) Combo Warrior: Deal +5% damage per level for every hit in a combo. (Max: 2) Gambler: Get a random item via /gamble (1h cooldown). (Max: 2) Blast Resistance!: Take no damage from explosions. (Max: 1) TRANSCENDED (0.5%) Heart Triplets: Instantly grants 3 extra max hearts. (Max: 1) SECOND LIFE: Acts like a Totem of Undying (1h cooldown). (Max: 1) BackPack: Gives access to a private chest via /chest. (Max: 2, for a double chest) Strength Maddnes: Deal 3x damage for 3s upon hitting an enemy (10m cooldown). (Max: 1) # Crafting There is one crucial crafting recipe in this plugin: the **Power Roll** ``` [D] [N] [D] [N] [S] [N] [D] [N] [D] ``` D = Diamond Block N = Netherite Ingot S = Nether Star # Commands


**User Commands (No OP Needed)**

```/roll``` - Use a Powerup Roll to get new Powerups.

```/powerups``` - Lists your active Powerups.

```/removepowerup (powerup_name)``` - Turns an active Powerup back into an item.

```/removepowerup roll``` - Turns a Powerup Roll from your count back into an item.

(Ability Commands) - ```/fly```, ```/leap```, ```/chest```, ```/gamble```, ```/creeper```, ```/food```, ```/jumper```, ```/miningdream```.



**Admin Commands (OP Needed)**

```/powerup list``` - Shows a list of all 33 Powerups.

```/powerup give (powerup_name)``` - Gives you the specified Powerup as an item.


# Important Notes - Progress Saves! All your Powerups and Rolls are saved when you log out and will be there when you rejoin. - First Join Only! You only get the 3 free rolls the very first time you join the server. After that, you must earn them.
